name: Python Codespace
postStartCommand: sh -c 'pkill -f "Xtigervnc :1" 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f "novnc_proxy.*6080" 2>/dev/null || true; setsid Xtigervnc :1 -geometry 1280x800 -depth 24 -SecurityTypes None </dev/null >/tmp/vnc.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; setsid fluxbox --display :1 </dev/null >/tmp/fluxbox.log 2>&1 & setsid /usr/share/novnc/utils/novnc_proxy --vnc localhost:5901 --listen 0.0.0.0:6080 </dev/null >/tmp/novnc.log 2>&1 &'
